properties.Long Description:
Ragdoll Flip 3D throws you into a wild world of physics where your only goal is simple: flip, fling, and crash your ragdoll in the most ridiculous ways possible. Tap, drag, and release to launch your floppy character through 3D levels packed with platforms, walls, and crazy obstacles.

Master the art of timing and angle as you send your ragdoll flying through the air. Watch every limb bend and twist with realistic ragdoll physics while you try to land perfect flips, reach distant platforms, or smash through breakable objects. Each level challenges you to aim just right, hit the target zone, and score big combo points.

As you progress, unlock new stages with higher platforms, moving traps, rotating blocks, and risky gaps that demand precision and creativity. Collect rewards to discover fresh ragdoll skins and fun outfits, making each launch look different and even more hilarious. Play again and again to beat your best scores, find new crash routes, and discover hidden ways to complete levels.

Easy one-touch controls, quick levels, and satisfying 3D physics make this an ideal offline arcade game for short breaks or long play sessions. If you enjoy physics games, stunt simulators, or silly crash challenges, this ragdoll flipping game will keep you coming back for "just one more launch". Download now and see how far you can flip!
properties.Product Features:
🤸 Ragdoll Flipping Action — Tap, aim, and launch your 3D ragdoll through the air
🧱 Physics-Based Levels — Bounce off platforms, walls, and obstacles with realistic motion
🎯 Target Challenges — Land in goal zones, hit markers, and chase high scores
🚧 Crazy Obstacles — Dodge spikes, moving blocks, and risky gaps as you fly
🎭 Unlockable Characters — Collect new ragdoll skins and funny outfits
🕹️ Simple One-Touch Play — Easy to learn physics arcade gameplay for all ages
